home_country_note: The country the user lives in (setup fills this in). Used to match places like 'Lyon' and 'Lyon, France'.
location_keywords_note: First-pass filter for job feeds: lowercase city, area and country names near the user (setup fills these in). Claude still checks distance and remote rules when scoring.
top_job_threshold_note: Jobs scoring this or higher are drafted and prepared first, every run.
max_fills_note: Applications drafted, prepared and filled per run. Filling forms uses a lot of Claude usage: lower this if you hit your plan's limits.
sweep_note: Target-company careers pages checked per run (rotation; priority companies every other day).
keep_means_apply_note: true: every job kept on the dashboard is one you apply to; anything not worth applying to is removed (Recycle Bin/Trash) and never comes back.
ntfy_note: Phone notifications via the free ntfy app. Setup creates a random topic name; it works like a private address. Notifications never contain personal details. Empty = off.
auto_submit_note: OFF. Claude never clicks Submit; you always submit yourself.
blocked_sites_note: Sites Claude never opens, reads or automates (their rules forbid bots and can get your account banned). Job alert EMAILS from them are fine; Claude finds the same job on the company's own site.
